title: Boardwalk and sheep

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Keep a single activity legible so the relationship between a person and a place remains easy to understand.
strategic_value: A walking figure and sheep can add a quieter nature-oriented scene to Helsinki’s city repertoire.
demonstration: A walking figure crosses an angular ochre boardwalk with two white sheep and a patch of vegetation on green.
practical_value: Use a compact activity composition when a larger collage would distract from the message.

content_islands.name: Walking scene
content_islands.spec: Center the figure on the angled boardwalk and place the sheep on opposite sides.

content_islands.name: Landscape patch
content_islands.spec: Use the ochre-and-black vegetation to anchor the lower right.
